entries.clue: Hard white electric beam that follows the star around the darkened ring
Vast canvas marquee hoisted on poles over the whole show
Company of performers who travel, rehearse and take a bow as one

Blinding headache with zigzag lights, sending you to a dark room
Frenchman whose stepped rings of glass hurl a small flame's light for miles
Sorting of arrivals by urgency rather than by who came first
Tender pimple on the rim of the lid, gone in a week or so
Darling of Longstone who rowed out to the Forfarshire survivors in 1838
Dreaded reef off Plymouth, first lit by Winstanley's daring tower in 1698
Three shorts, three longs, three shorts from a vessel in distress
